admin.title: Purchasing

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.historyNote: Purchase history shows each supplier's purchase orders; open an order to see its receipts. A history per product is not available yet.

form.description: Who you buy from and how long you have to pay them.
form.name: Supplier name
form.termsHint: Used for the due date of the supplier's invoice.
form.termsInvalid: Payment terms are a whole number of days from 0 to 365.

detail.title: Receipt {number}
detail.needCostPermission: The cost of this receipt has not been applied to the products. Someone who may change cost prices can do it from here.

suggest.intro: Variants at or below their reorder level, with a suggested quantity, grouped by the supplier you last ordered them from.
suggest.emptyText: No variant in this branch is at or below its reorder level.

editor.title: New purchase order
editor.subtitle: Choose the supplier and the variants you want. You can send it to the supplier from the next page.
editor.notDraft: Only a draft purchase order can be edited.
editor.branchLocked: The branch cannot change after the order is created.
editor.linesHint: Search a product and add the variants you are ordering, then enter the quantity and the cost per unit.
editor.attachHint: Pictures or PDF, up to 8 MB each.
editor.attachType: Attach a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF file.
editor.attachSize: A file is larger than 8 MB.

errors.quantity: Every line needs a quantity from 1 to 1,000,000.
errors.cost: Every line needs a unit cost (a number with up to two decimals).

detail.title: Purchase order {number}
detail.subtitle: {supplier}, receiving at {branch}
detail.balanceSettled: Nothing is due to the supplier on this order.
detail.noPayments: No payment has been recorded yet.
detail.attachHint: Pictures or PDF, up to 8 MB each.
detail.attachType: Attach a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF file.
detail.attachSize: A file is larger than 8 MB.
detail.attachSave: Add the files to this order

dialogs.failed: That did not work. Try again.

send.title: Send to supplier?
send.description: {number} will be marked as sent. You can still receive goods and cancel it afterwards.

cancel.title: Cancel this order?
cancel.description: {number} will be cancelled and cannot be used again. An order with payments recorded cannot be cancelled.

closeShort.title: Close short?
closeShort.description: Stop waiting for the rest of {number}. What has not arrived will not be received.

receive.title: Receive goods
receive.description: Book what arrived for {number}. Accepted units are added to the branch stock; damaged or refused units are only recorded.
receive.over: Only {count} are still expected on this line.
receive.nothing: Enter an accepted or a damaged quantity on at least one line.
receive.costNote: The product cost price is updated with the method set in the settings, but only when you may change cost prices. Otherwise someone who may can apply it from the receipt.

invoice.title: Supplier invoice
invoice.description: Record the invoice that came with {number}.
invoice.dueHint: Left empty it is the invoice date plus the supplier's payment terms.
invoice.amountHint: Optional. When given, it replaces the order value as what you owe.
invoice.amountInvalid: Enter an amount with up to two decimals.

pay.title: Pay supplier
pay.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above zero with up to two decimals.
pay.exceeds: The payment cannot be more than the {due} still due.
pay.accountHint: Choose a cash, bank or mobile banking account to book this in the cash book.
pay.noAccount: Do not book in the cash book
